_readme: Copy to sources.json and edit. Without a sources.json the script uses built-in defaults (the per-user skill folders of common agents, plus project skills under ~/GitHub, ~/src, ~/code and ~/projects). kind: installed = an agent lists these in every session; project = loaded inside that repo; catalog = cloned but not installed. Installed folders are scanned one level deep (what agents load); set recursive: true to scan a whole tree. Globs (*) are allowed; missing paths are skipped.

budgets._readme: Optional. How much of the skill list (names + descriptions) an agent shows before it drops or shortens entries. Either a character count or {fraction, contexts}: a share of the model's context window in tokens, with the context sizes to toggle between. Limits vary by agent, version and model; the values below are estimates and placeholders. Keys match the 'agent' field of installed sources.

Claude Code.note: Unofficial estimate: ~1% of the model's context window.
